chapters.title: Factorial: the base case and call stack
facts: base case is a stopping condition
Each function call allocates an activation frame on the call stack

chapters.title: Fibonacci: exponential branching calls
facts: Naive recursive Fibonacci makes two branching calls per step, resulting in exponential O(2ⁿ) time
Returning from a recursive call pops its frame off the call stack

chapters.title: Tower of Hanoi: divide and conquer recursion
facts: recursive case breaks the input into smaller subproblems
Each function call allocates an activation frame on the call stack

chapters.title: Palindrome: shrinking inward recursively
facts: recursive function is a function that calls itself directly or indirectly
Returning from a recursive call pops its frame off the call stack and resumes the caller

chapters.title: Recursion summary and stack limits
facts: Without a reachable base case, infinite recursion exhausts stack memory and causes a stack overflow
Calculating factorial recursively has a recurrence of T(n) = T(n - 1) + O(1), running in O(n) time and O(n) stack space
Naive recursive Fibonacci makes two branching calls per step, resulting in exponential O(2ⁿ) time
